info.title: Custom API
info.description:
Welcome to the Custom API !!!! .

📌 HOW TO USE THIS API (STEP BY STEP)

1️⃣ Register a new user using **POST /api/auth/register** (public).
2️⃣ Login using **POST /api/auth/login** to receive a JWT token.
3️⃣ Click the **Authorize 🔐** button (top-right corner).
4️⃣ Paste the token like this:

Bearer <your_jwt_token>

5️⃣ Click **Authorize**.

🔓 PUBLIC APIs:
- Register
- Login

🔒 PROTECTED APIs (require token):
- Profile
- Student Create / View / Update / Delete

⚠️ Any API with a lock icon requires authorization.

Bearer.name: Authorization
Bearer.description:
JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. Example: "Bearer <token>" 

 Enter JWT token as: **Bearer <token>**
